## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate 18%).

**What I did:**
1. Reviewed deployment history — confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production and that **v2.3.0** was the most recent healthy production release.
2. Rolled back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The first attempt partially failed (orchestrator error left us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1), so I retried and the rollout completed.
3. **Verified recovery:** all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on v2.3.0, the service is healthy, and the error rate dropped to 0.2%.
4. Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the rollback and noting the follow-up: root-cause the v2.3.1 regression (which also failed in staging as v2.3.1-rc) before any re-deploy.
